caption: The landing page says it in one line: your whole business, one workspace. A WhatsApp chase from the Chase agent is the proof on the right.
alt: AdminOS landing page headline reading Your whole business. One workspace., beside a WhatsApp conversation where the Chase agent follows up an unpaid invoice.

caption: Six agents with names and jobs. Alex answers customers, Chase recovers debt, Care watches team wellbeing.
alt: Cards for the Alex, Chase and Care AI agents, each with a small live example of its work.

caption: Langa is the business mentor. It reads your own numbers before it advises.
alt: The Langa AI business mentor chat, answering a question about cash flow using the business's collection rate.

caption: The Command Center. One screen: what is stuck, what needs a decision, how the goals are moving.
alt: AdminOS Command Center showing R22,031 stuck in collections and a list of decisions waiting.

caption: Cash Cockpit. What you are owed, how old it is, and who to chase first.
alt: Cash Cockpit with net position, amount owed to you and an aging pipeline of overdue invoices.

caption: The invoice register. Status, amount outstanding and recovery stage on every line.
alt: Invoice register table listing contacts, amounts, due dates and status.

caption: Bank statement reconcile. Upload a CSV, see a payment matched to its invoice, confirm with one tap.
alt: Bank and Reconciliation screen with an uploaded statement line matched to an invoice for confirmation.

caption: A 90-day cash forecast, labelled as an estimate, with the runway in days.
alt: Cashflow screen with a 90-day forecast chart and a cash runway figure.

caption: The health score, broken into six dimensions so a founder can see which one to fix.
alt: Business Health screen with an overall score of 85 out of 100 and a radar chart of six dimensions.

caption: Accountant reports. Pick a month and hand over a clean pack: income statement, VAT201 working paper, journal.
alt: Accountant Reports screen listing downloadable reports for a chosen month.

caption: The compliance calendar. Each SARS and CIPC obligation, its due date, and the penalty for missing it.
alt: Compliance Calendar showing overdue tax obligations with the penalty that applies to each.

caption: A POPIA register of what personal data is held, why, for how long, and who can see it.
alt: POPIA compliance centre with a register of data categories, legal basis, retention and access.

caption: Licences and permits, with expiry tracking so a lapse never arrives as a surprise.
alt: Licences and Permits screen listing licences with expiry dates and status.

caption: The WhatsApp inbox. Conversations tagged by sentiment and status, with one-tap Draft reply and Summarise helpers.
alt: Inbox listing customer WhatsApp conversations with sentiment tags, and AI helper buttons under the reply box.

caption: Reach. A broadcast composer that checks consent before it sends.
alt: New campaign form for a WhatsApp broadcast, with an audience selector and a consent notice.

caption: Ops Cockpit. Stock below reorder level, today's bookings and open tasks in one view.
alt: Ops Cockpit highlighting two products at or below reorder level.

caption: Tasks as a board. Urgent and overdue work is pushed to the top, not buried.
alt: Task board with To do, In progress, In review and Done columns and urgency banners.

caption: Supplier scorecard with B-BBEE level and ownership, because procurement in South Africa asks.
alt: Suppliers screen with counts of B-BBEE rated, women-owned and youth-owned suppliers.

caption: Autonomy settings. For each action the owner picks Auto, Draft or Off. Firm and money-moving actions default to Draft or Off.
alt: Autonomy settings listing actions such as invoice reminders and final demands, each with Auto, Draft and Off options.

caption: Load-shedding status, rand exchange rates and a phone-number validator, built in because the local context is the point.
alt: Integrations screen showing a load-shedding status, ZAR exchange rates and a phone number validator.
